about: The one error catalog (#2449; owner 2026-10-21 「还有，错误那一块，是不是应该有一种统一的方式？我不想错误都散落在各处」). Adding an error = adding an entry here, then `node scripts/sync-error-catalog.mjs`. README.md has the rules.

errors.agent: 品牌与资料 failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 品牌资料出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: 品牌与资料 could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 品牌资料暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud sandbox is being archived after a long idle, so {operation}{on_target} waits until it is stored (usually under a minute, a few minutes at most)
errors.next: Run the command again in a minute: the sandbox then starts again from its archive with its files as they were.
errors.user: 云端沙箱正在归档，稍后会继续。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud sandbox is being attached or started again, so {operation}{on_target} waits
errors.next: Run the command again in a moment.
errors.user: 云端沙箱正在启动，稍后会继续。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud sandbox could not be started for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Run the command again shortly; if it keeps failing, run it on the person's computer (env_use) or tell the person the cloud sandbox is unavailable.
errors.user: 云端沙箱暂时启动不了。

errors.agent: The conversation's cloud sandbox is there, but its host program (hostd) did not answer {operation} within its start-up wait
errors.next: Run the command again in a minute; if it keeps failing, run it on the person's computer (env_use) or tell the person the cloud sandbox is unavailable.
errors.user: 云端沙箱还没准备好，稍后再试。

errors.agent: Connections are not open for this account yet ({operation})
errors.next: Continue without a connection; do not retry. Tell the person in one plain sentence that connecting outside services is not open for them yet.
errors.user: 连接功能还没有对你开放。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the connection file would not be valid, so nothing was registered; the cause names every problem by file and field
errors.next: Fix each named field in the connection file, save it as a new version of its space, then check or publish that version again.
errors.user: 连接文件有错误，没有发布。

errors.agent: {operation}: there is no connection file at {target}
errors.next: Check the path and the version: the ref is <space>/<path>@<version> and the path names the .yaml file itself (connections/<name>.yaml). List the space's files at that version if unsure.
errors.user: 找不到这个连接文件。

errors.agent: {operation}: connection id {target} is already published from another file
errors.next: Unpublish the connection that holds this id first, or give this file another id; one id is one file at a time, so it is always clear which file runs.
errors.user: 这个连接名已经被另一个连接文件占用。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the request is not valid; the cause says which part
errors.next: Fix the named part and call again: a connection ref is <space>/<path>@<version> (wrk_…/connections/<name>.yaml@<version>), a connection id is a slug such as orders.
errors.user: 请求内容不对，请检查后重试。

errors.agent: {operation}: connection {target} is not published
errors.next: List the person's connections to see which are published, or publish this one first.
errors.user: 这个连接还没有发布。

errors.agent: {operation}: connection {target} has no earlier published version to go back to
errors.next: Name the version to pin instead (publish that ref), or leave the current one.
errors.user: 这个连接没有更早的发布版本。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: no signing secret of this connection waits to be shown; the cause says why (shown once already, not looked at within 24 hours, or shown at the person's own publish)
errors.next: Do not retry: a signing secret is shown once. To give the sender a new one, name a new secret in the connection file's signing credential (secret:<new name>) and publish the file again; the new secret is shown once.
errors.user: 这个签名密钥已经看过或过期了，不能再显示。

errors.agent: {operation}: a connection file cannot be read from {target} yet
errors.next: Keep connection files in a 作品 the person owns (wrk_…), e.g. connections/<name>.yaml; other spaces follow when the Space Server serves them.
errors.user: 这个空间里的连接文件暂时还不能使用。

errors.agent: The connector failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 连接器出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The connector could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 连接器暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: Control failed on {operation} with an error no handler names (a platform bug)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Report the request id; continue another way.
errors.user: 出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Task dispatch failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 派活出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Task dispatch could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 派活暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The credential {target} that {operation} needs is missing, revoked or needs a new login
errors.next: Do not ask for the value in chat. Tell the person in one plain sentence which credential to add or reconnect in 连接 / 设置 → 密钥, then continue once they have.
errors.user: 这个连接需要的密钥还没设置或已失效，请到「连接」里重新设置。

errors.agent: Custom tools failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 自定义工具出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Custom tools could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 自定义工具暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: Control's database could not be reached for {operation}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds.
errors.user: 服务正忙，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The 经验仓库 failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 经验仓库出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The 经验仓库 could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 经验仓库暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) refused the arguments of {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: The cause names the argument and what it must be; fix that and call once more.
errors.user: 参数不对，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) could not set the write boundary for {operation}{on_target}, so the command did not run
errors.next: Do not retry unchanged. Tell the person in one plain sentence that the computer could not protect that folder (it may be on a USB stick or network drive, or owned by another account); a folder on an NTFS disk they own works.
errors.user: 电脑没能保护这个文件夹，命令没有运行。

errors.agent: Folder mode on the person's computer cannot confine local tools for {operation}{on_target}: its sandbox needs a one-time change only that computer's administrator can make (on Ubuntu, an AppArmor rule that lets AgentRouter's own sandbox program make user namespaces: `sudo agentrouter sandbox userns install`; elsewhere, a kernel setting); `agentrouter sandbox setup` cannot make it
errors.next: Do not retry. Tell the person, in one plain sentence, the exact command the cause gives and what it is for (it asks for the computer's login password); after they ran it, call once more. Until then nothing runs in that folder.
errors.user: 这台电脑要管理员确认一次设置，按提示运行那一行命令后再试。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault on that computer, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done; updating or restarting AgentRouter on that computer may fix it.
errors.user: 电脑上的 AgentRouter 出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The AgentRouter app on the person's computer (hostd) could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Check list_devices: if that computer is offline, tell the person and do not resend now; otherwise try once more in a few seconds.
errors.user: 电脑暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The person's computer is linked, but the AgentRouter app there (hostd) is still starting the server that does {operation}{on_target} (in folder mode it starts confined, which can take half a minute or more); nothing ran
errors.next: Call it once more in about 10 seconds. It is not an old AgentRouter: do not ask the person to update.
errors.user: 电脑上的工具还在启动，稍后会继续。

errors.agent: The person's computer is offline, so {operation}{on_target} did not run there (it is not linked right now, it dropped and did not come back within the reconnect wait, or the link gateway could not reach it)
errors.next: The same call works once that computer is online again (remote_hosts / list_devices shows it): ask the person to start `agentrouter link` on it (the terminal must stay open), then call again; meanwhile keep working where you are (env_use cloud). Jobs already started there keep running. Do not resend in a loop.
errors.user: 电脑没有连上：在那台电脑上重新运行 agentrouter link。

errors.agent: This Agent's definition sets resource limits for its environment (environment_memory_mb / environment_processes / environment_cpu_percent), and the person's computer did not take them for {operation}{on_target}, so nothing runs there unlimited
errors.next: Do not retry. Tell the person their computer could not apply the limits (the cause says which value or which local tool), or keep working in your cloud sandbox (env_use cloud).
errors.user: 这台电脑没能设上这个 Agent 要求的资源上限，所以没有在上面运行。

errors.agent: This Agent's definition sets resource limits for its environment, and the agentrouter on the person's computer ({operation}{on_target}) predates them, so nothing runs there unlimited
errors.next: Do not retry. Ask the person to update agentrouter on that computer (then link again), or keep working in your cloud sandbox (env_use cloud).
errors.user: 这台电脑上的 agentrouter 太旧，设不了这个 Agent 要求的资源上限。请先更新。

errors.agent: The link to the host dropped while {operation}{on_target} was running, so it may or may not have taken effect there (a read-only call is already sent again once)
errors.next: Check the state there first (read the file or list the folder again), then redo only what did not happen.
errors.user: 连接中断了，这一步可能没有完成。

errors.agent: Memory failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 记忆出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Memory could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 记忆暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: {target} is not in this Agent's reach, so {operation} did not run: neither its definition (with its slots as the install maps them) nor a grant gives it (the cause lists what it reaches and how to add it)
errors.next: Work with the spaces and computers this Agent reaches. If it needs this one: the person (through their Main Agent) or the Agent that dispatched you can grant it for this conversation (agent_grant), or the definition can name it (the cause shows the line). Ask; calling again before a grant will not work.
errors.user: 这个 Agent 的定义里没有包含它，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: The platform tool failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 这一步出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The platform tool could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 这一步没连上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: {target} is not a tool of this conversation ({operation}); the cause says why
errors.next: Use a tool from your tool list for this step; calling the same name again will not work in this conversation.
errors.user: 这个工具在这次对话里用不了。

errors.agent: {target} was removed from the platform's tools after this conversation's tool list was made ({operation}); the cause says when
errors.next: Do what the call was for with the replacement named here, with the arguments it describes; do not call the removed tool again.
errors.user: 这个工具已经换成新的了。

errors.agent: {operation} is missing arguments the tool requires{on_target}; the cause names them, the arguments it does not take, and its current input schema
errors.next: Call it again with every argument the cause lists as required (the tool may have gained one since your tool list was made); leave out the arguments it does not take.
errors.user: 这一步的参数不完整。

errors.agent: The person's computer has too many open preview connections to answer {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Wait a few seconds, then open it once more; close previews you no longer need.
errors.user: 电脑上同时打开的预览连接太多，稍等几秒再刷新。

errors.agent: Nothing listens on that port of the person's computer for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Check that the dev server runs on that computer and listens on 127.0.0.1 (its log, or a command there); start it again if it stopped.
errors.user: 网页没有响应。它可能正在启动，或者刚刚停下了：稍等几秒再刷新，还不行就回到对话，让 AI 看看。

errors.agent: On the person's computer, linked in folder mode, the port of {operation}{on_target} is listened on by a program outside the link's sandbox (one of the person's own), which a folder-mode link never opens to the cloud
errors.next: Do not retry. Start the dev server with a command in this environment (then its port opens), or use the port of the server you started; the person's own programs are previewed only when they link with 完全访问.
errors.user: 这个端口上是电脑上别的程序，文件夹模式不会打开它的网页预览。

errors.agent: The person's computer is linked in folder mode, where its ports are not opened to the cloud, so {operation}{on_target} cannot reach it
errors.next: Do not retry. Fetch the page with a command on that computer instead (curl), and tell the person in one plain sentence that the preview of a computer linked in folder mode does not open yet.
errors.user: 这台电脑只链接了文件夹，还打不开它上面的网页预览。

errors.agent: The Space Server (project-service) failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 项目服务出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The Space Server refused {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: The cause names what was refused; fix that before trying again.
errors.user: 项目服务拒绝了这次操作。

errors.agent: The Space Server (project-service) could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 项目服务暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: Control cannot sync the session's 作品 copy now for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Go on with the files in your environment; they may lag behind your view until a later sync. If a file you need is missing there, read it through your view instead.
errors.user: 作品同步暂时不可用，稍后会再同步。

errors.agent: A sync of the session's 作品 copy was asked wrongly for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: This is a fault of the runner, not of your work: go on; the files in your environment may lag behind your view until the next turn.
errors.user: 作品同步出错了，下一轮会再同步。

errors.agent: This conversation's session directory (its view through the Space Server) could not be joined for {operation}{on_target}, so the turn did not start: a session with a view never runs without it
errors.next: Send the message again in a minute: the conversation's next lease joins its view again. If it keeps failing, tell the person the platform's file service is unavailable right now.
errors.user: 作品和资料暂时连不上，这次还没开始做，记录都还在。请稍后点重试。

errors.agent: This conversation's platform tools (its MCP server through the runner) could not be set up for {operation}{on_target}, so the turn did not start: a session never runs without its platform tools
errors.next: Send the message again in a minute: the conversation's next lease sets up its tools again. If it keeps failing, tell the person the platform is having trouble right now.
errors.user: 工具这次没接上，还没开始做，记录都还在。请稍后点重试。

errors.agent: The person's quota is used up, so {operation}{on_target} was refused
errors.next: Do not retry. Tell the person in one plain sentence that their quota is used up; they can top up or get a card (查看套餐), then ask again.
errors.user: 额度已用完，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: {operation} was refused: a budget is used up ({target})
errors.next: Do not retry and do not start more work. Report what you have done so far (task_report, or reply to the person) and say which budget ran out; the one who set it (the task's dispatcher or the Agent's owner) decides whether to give more.
errors.user: 这个 Agent 的额度上限已用完，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: {operation}: this Agent's definition does not allow working on {target}
errors.next: Move only to a host its reach.environment.allow admits (env_list lists them), or keep working where you are; tell the person if the work needs that host.
errors.user: 这个 Agent 不能在那台机器上工作。

errors.agent: The command output {target} was in the conversation's cloud sandbox, which has ended; its outputs went with it
errors.next: Run the command again if you still need its output.
errors.user: 云端沙箱已结束，它的输出也随之清除。

errors.agent: Scheduled tasks failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 定时任务出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: Scheduled tasks could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 定时任务暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: The scheduled task's agent is not usable for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Give agent as one of the person's published Agents by id (e.g. bili-digest) or a definition ref space/path@version, when the task is made. A task's Agent cannot be changed afterwards: make a new task and delete the old one.
errors.user: 这个定时任务要用的 Agent 写得不对。

errors.agent: A scheduled task cannot start an Agent for {operation}{on_target} (own Agents are not open to this person, or this server cannot start them)
errors.next: Make the task without agent (it then runs in this conversation), or tell the person their own Agents are not available to them yet.
errors.user: 定时任务现在还不能启动你自己的 Agent。

errors.agent: The scheduled task has no model access of its own for {operation}{on_target} (it was never given one from a conversation of the person, or 退出其他设备 revoked it)
errors.next: Set the task up again from a conversation of the person (schedule_update with its id from that conversation renews its access); runs start again after that.
errors.user: 定时任务的后台权限失效了：在任意对话里让 Agent 恢复一下这个任务。

errors.agent: {operation} was given an invalid secret{on_target}: a name is a letter then letters, digits, _ or - (at most 64), a value 1–65536 characters, a kind one of api_key, oauth, cookie, file, ssh_key, webhook_signing
errors.next: Fix the name or kind and call again. Never put a secret value in chat or in a tool argument.
errors.user: 密钥的名字或内容不符合要求。

errors.agent: {operation} may not use the credential {target}: it is not granted to this connection or tool
errors.next: Use only the connections your definition lists. If this one should have access, tell the person in one plain sentence to grant it.
errors.user: 这个连接没有使用该密钥的权限。

errors.agent: The secret store failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 密钥服务出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: The secret store could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 密钥服务暂时连不上，稍后再试。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the space's definition (.ar/space.yaml or .ar/views/*.yaml) would not be valid, so nothing was submitted; the cause names every problem by file and field
errors.next: Fix each named file and field in your draft (describe shows how your session sees the definition now), then submit again. Your other changes stay in the draft.
errors.user: 空间定义有错误，这次没有提交。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: nothing is waiting to be submitted (the cause says which paths); what this session wrote is already a version of the space, or those paths have no changes
errors.next: Nothing to redo: go on from the space's current version (space_read shows it). Submit only after a space_write that leaves changes in your draft.
errors.user: 没有要提交的改动，之前的修改已经保存了。

errors.agent: The args of {operation}{on_target} are not an object of the op's params by name
errors.next: Call space_op with op describe to see the op's params, then send args as an object such as {"path": "…"}.
errors.user: 参数不对，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: The space failed while doing {operation}{on_target} (a fault in the platform, not in your call)
errors.next: Retrying will not help. Continue another way, and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
errors.user: 空间出错了，已记录。

errors.agent: space_op needs space (a ref from space_list) and op (one of its kind's ops, or describe); {operation} gave neither or only one
errors.next: Call space_list for the ref, then space_op with that space and an op its kind declares (op describe lists them).
errors.user: 参数不对，这一步没有执行。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: this op was removed from the space's definition; the cause names the version that removed it and the ops it has now
errors.next: Use one of the ops it has now (space_op describe lists them). If you need the removed one, add it back to .ar/space.yaml and submit.
errors.user: 这个操作已经从空间里移除了。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the space declares no task of that name; the message names the tasks it declares
errors.next: Use one of the tasks it declares (space_op describe lists them), or declare it under tasks: in its .ar/space.yaml and run it again.
errors.user: 这个空间没有这个任务。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the task's after: chain loops; the message names the tasks that wait for each other
errors.next: Fix after: in the space's .ar/space.yaml so the tasks no longer wait for each other, then run it again.
errors.user: 任务之间的先后关系绕成了一个圈。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: this environment lacks what the task requires (os, tools with versions, a GPU, or the host that holds the space); the message names each
errors.next: Run it in an environment that has it (env_use to a computer that does), or change the task's requires in .ar/space.yaml.
errors.user: 当前环境缺少这个任务需要的工具或系统。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the environment lacks tools the task requires, and their toolchain layer is being built now (once per tool set; afterwards any environment mounts it in seconds); nothing has run
errors.next: Call env_task again in about a minute.
errors.user: 任务需要的工具正在准备，稍后会自动可用。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the task commits its deliverables somewhere this environment cannot write (not a 作品 the person can change, or a path outside it)
errors.next: Commit into the 作品 itself (commit: { to: self, path: … }) or a 作品 id the person can change.
errors.user: 任务的产物不能提交到那个位置。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: declared tasks cannot run in this environment yet (a computer environment, or not open in this conversation)
errors.next: Move back to your cloud sandbox with env_use, or run the task's command yourself.
errors.user: 这个环境暂时不能执行声明的任务。

errors.agent: {operation}{on_target}: the environment could not prepare or finish the task (staging its inputs, listing its outputs or copying its deliverables failed); the cause says where
errors.next: Check the environment with a command (disk space, the 作品 folder), then run the task again.
errors.user: 运行环境没能准备好这个任务。

errors.agent: The space could not be reached for {operation}{on_target}
errors.next: Try once more in a few seconds. If it fails again, continue another way and tell the person in one plain sentence what could not be done.
